title: Group relationships and gradation
basic_overview: Main-group trends reflect valence configuration, size, shielding and bonding. First members are often anomalous.

extra_info_content.short_trick: First member anomaly = small size + high charge density + limited orbital set.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Compare valence shell. 2. Compare size/IE. 3. Check inert pair. 4. Check multiple bonding.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
